pretreatment: thermal oxidation at 900 °C to produce ~30 Å sacrificial oxide followed by surface etching in dilute HF acid solution
evidence: The starting surfaces of Si(100) ATR crystals were prepared in air by thermal or wet-chemical treatment before each exposure sequence and were loaded into the system within 10 min of preparation. Several pretreatment approaches were studied, including chemical surface oxidation to produce 5 Å hydroxyl-rich SiO2 (following the common RCA oxidation process: aqueous H2O2/NH4OH at 45 °C) and silicon/hydrogen termination by thermal oxidation at 900 °C to produce ~30 Å sacrificial oxide followed by surface etching in dilute HF acid solution.
